jobs.title: Epicor Project Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
Remote - United States

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Travel:
Occasional travel to client sites

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Epicor Project Manager
to lead Epicor Kinetic/Epicor ERP implementation projects
for manufacturing and distribution organizations.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record managing ERP implementations from project kickoff through go-live and post-implementation review
, with strong experience in project planning, stakeholder management, risk management, budgets, schedules, and change control.

This is a hands-on project management role working closely with ERP consultants, client leadership, plant/operations teams, technical resources, and Epicor stakeholders
to ensure successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Epicor Kinetic / Epicor ERP (E10) implementations from initiation through go-live and post-implementation review.
Develop and manage detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, milestones, resources, and deliverables.
Manage project scope, requirements, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests.
Coordinate internal consultants, client project teams, subject-matter experts, and Epicor resources.
Facilitate project kickoff meetings, status meetings, steering committee meetings, and project reviews.
Provide clear and timely communication to executive stakeholders, management, project teams, and plant-floor personnel.
Monitor overall project health and proactively identify potential schedule, budget, resource, or scope issues.
Track project progress against established milestones and deliverables.
Manage escalations and develop corrective action plans when projects move off track.
Maintain project documentation, status reports, action items, risk registers, and project governance.
Support multiple concurrent ERP engagements and maintain visibility into overall portfolio health.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of project delivery processes, methodologies, and best practices.
Follow the Epicor Signature Methodology throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Epicor Implementation Methodology

Candidates should have practical familiarity with the major stages of the Epicor Signature Methodology
, including:

Prepare
Plan
Design
Validate
Deploy

Required Qualifications

5+ years of ERP project management experience, preferably supporting manufacturing or distribution organizations.
Hands-on experience managing Epicor Kinetic or Epicor E10 implementation projects - REQUIRED.
Demonstrated experience managing ERP implementations through go-live.
Strong understanding of project management fundamentals, including:
Scope management
Schedule management
Budget management
Risk and issue management
Resource management
Change management
Stakeholder communication

Experience coordinating cross-functional implementation teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with both executive leadership and operational/plant-floor teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and concurrent projects in a consulting environment.
Willingness to travel occasionally to client locations.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP certification or equivalent project management certification.
Experience working within the Epicor partner, consulting, or implementation ecosystem.
Epicor-related training or certifications.
Experience with manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or other ERP-intensive environments.

What We're Looking For

This position is best suited for an ERP Project Manager who has actually managed Epicor implementations
, rather than a general PM who has only worked with ERP systems.

The Successful Candidate Should Be Able To Clearly Explain

Which Epicor Kinetic/E10 implementations they have managed.
Their specific role and responsibilities on each implementation.
The project scope, size, and duration.
Their involvement from planning through deployment/go-live.
How they managed risks, scope changes, budgets, timelines, and stakeholders.
Their experience working with manufacturing or distribution clients.

Epicor Kinetic/E10 implementation project management experience is a hard requirement and will be verified during the interview/reference process.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive base salary
Annual performance bonus based on individual and team performance
Medical and dental benefits
401(k) with company match after the introductory period
Fully remote work environment
Company-provided laptop and required software
Support for maintaining PM certifications
Ongoing Epicor training and professional development
Occasional travel to client sites

Work Environment

100% Remote within the United States
Occasional travel for client meetings, implementations, or company events
Collaborative consulting environment
Direct interaction with leadership and client stakeholders
Opportunity to play a key role in a growing ERP implementation practice

Ideal Candidate Profile

Target Titles

Epicor Project Manager | ERP Project Manager | Epicor Implementation Project Manager | ERP Implementation Manager | Senior ERP Project Manager | Epicor Program Manager

jobs.title: Project Manager/Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Company

The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation’s growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future.
At Cypress Creek Energy, we’re meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build.

That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career.

Overview

In collaboration with the Senior Director of Project Management, the Project Manager/Senior Project Manager will broadly serve as the overall point of contact and subject matter expert for a rolling portfolio of projects. The Project Manager/Senior Project Manager will work collaboratively with Business Development and Pre-Construction to support construction due diligence, including constructability reviews, risk analyses, developing project schedules, reviewing budgets and CAPEX estimates, and analyses of EPC RFP's, in support of construction projects. The Project Manager will provide tactical leadership for construction, assist in the development of strategic project objectives, provide direction for projects from late-stage development through the final construction phase, lead the management of construction contracts to ensure projects are on time and within budget, and ensure that safety, quality, cost, environmental, landowner, and legal requirements are properly addressed to support the project execution objectives.

Responsibilities

Support the Pre-Construction Department by actively participating in the EPC RFP process for assigned projects through contract execution
Participate in a formal turnover and acceptance of the project from Pre-Construction to Project Execution and turnover to Asset Management / O&M
Work to support, develop, and implement a project execution plan that is formally communicated to all project stakeholders
Understand the implications of various technical options and guide engineering designs to achieve the best solution for each situation
Ensure projects are adequately staffed, trained, and standard construction toolbox policies, procedures, and programs are adhered to ensuring all project communications, issues, change orders, and quality items are well documented
Provide leadership during project construction activities, ensuring safety, quality, schedule, cost, environmental, landowner, and other project requirements are met or exceeded
Understand and manage all aspects of project construction contracts (EPC, Owner-Furnished Equipment, Interconnection Agreement, technical consultants) and hold the contractors and suppliers accountable to contractual requirements to ensure projects are completed on time and under budget
Institute a culture of ownership and accountability by empowering team members to make decisions and holding them accountable to do so
Consolidate, manage, and analyze budgets, costs, forecasts, and utilization against established financial goals
Perform the planning and hiring of competent field staff to ensure adequate resources are in place for effective and timely execution of committed projects
Develop effective relationships with internal departments, contractors, suppliers, landowners, and other stakeholders
Provide strategic direction and manage the development of Construction Site Managers and provide supervision, guidance, and mentorship to assigned staff at all levels
Reinforce a team approach throughout the enterprise, both on projects and internal initiatives
Effectively communicate relevant information to superiors
Champion change and effectively manage the implementation of new ideas, processes, tools, etc.
Manage the relationships with all external entities during the construction phase of the project such as local government, permitting agencies, pipeline utility companies, and interconnecting utilities
Once awarded, managing construction contracts including tracking deliverables, schedules, cashflow, managing RFIs, change orders, and providing notices or dispute resolution if required
Ensuring that the project complies with applicable Environmental, Health and Safety regulations
Provide summary management reports on the status on all aspects of the project to multiple stakeholders.
Interface with the lender’s engineer as required including monthly reporting, project review meetings, performance testing, draw certification, etc.
Managing Operations and Maintenance contract handoff and coordination and ensure closeout of EPC contract at Final Acceptance
Additional duties as required

Education & Experience Required

Minimum of a bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management or related field.
Project Management Professional certification a plus
4+ years in the renewable energy sector or industrial construction or capital project management
Advanced knowledge of construction management and constructing methods for large projects, contract management, procurement, and supply chain management, environmental and building permitting, and transportation logistics
Basic knowledge of construction labor relations throughout the US
Competency in analytical problem solving, customer/partner relationships, and technology expertise.
Proficient understanding of entire solar project life cycle
Experience with High Voltage Interconnection aspects of a project’s scope of work.
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office (i.e. Word, Project, Excel, PowerBI), Procore, SiteTracker, NetSuite and other discipline-relevant software.

Personal Characteristics

Self-motivated, capable of performing tasks with minimal supervision.
Ability to work well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and meet deadlines.
Strong organizational skills and multitasking ability.
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
Commitment to continuous improvement and analytical problem-solving.
Ability to create and implement programs/policies involving multiple departments.
Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Energy

Additional Information

Travel is expected to be 35%
In-office, full remote, or hybrid employment will be considered.
Must hold a valid driver’s license

Location:
This role can be based in any of our U.S. office locations or remotely for the right candidate.

Benefits

15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays.
401(k) Match
Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance
Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave
Tuition Reimbursement
Phone Bill Reimbursement
Company Swag

A note to Recruiting Agencies Cypress Creek Energy Human Resources team does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCE and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team.

Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to HR@ccrenew.com.

jobs.title: Project Manager, CPG
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A Day In The Life

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client. This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities

Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements

Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
Bachelor’s degree required
Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Benefits & Perks

Base salary + commission opportunities
Medical Bonus
15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
Paid Social Security
Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/ . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction

TheZebra.com meets customers right where their search for car and home insurance begins: online. We provide easy-to-use tools and services, plus friendly, licensed agents who offer advice and guidance at any point along the way. The Zebra has helped customers compare over 74 million quotes since 2012. At its heart, both insurance and tech industry veterans collaborate together to simplify insurance shopping for customers. In today's digital world, The Zebra's customer-centered approach offers people the choices they want and simplicity they need.

The Zebra was recently named Austin Business Journal's 2026 Best Place to Work. Our motto is "All Stripes Welcome." Building the best product, the best teams, and the best company comes from inviting a diverse array of voices, backgrounds, and perspectives to contribute, making everyone feel welcome. Our Zeebs are passionate about learning, growing, and working together to tackle exciting problems.

We're seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional programs at The Zebra. You'll bring structure and momentum to our highest-priority strategic initiatives and ensure teams are aligned and executing.

Location

Our company headquarters are in Austin, TX, but our employees work remotely across the US. For folks who live around Austin, we offer the option to join us in our office or opt for a hybrid setup. Whether you prefer the structure of an office, the convenience of remote work, or a mix of both, we support what works best for you!

Please note: at this time we are not able to hire in Massachusetts.

What You'll Do

Lead planning, coordination, and delivery of complex cross-functional programs and strategic initiatives
Build program frameworks including roadmaps, milestones, risk registers, and decision logs
Partner with executive sponsors and functional leads to align priorities and remove blockers
Communicate program status, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders at all levels
Drive accountability across teams and escalate when needed to keep initiatives on track
Identify process improvement opportunities and lead efforts to build better ways of working

What We're Looking For

6+ years of program or project management experience in a technology company
Proven ability to manage complex, ambiguous cross-functional initiatives
Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Asana, or similar
PMP or similar certification a plus; strong ownership mindset required

Why Work Here?

When we say “All Stripes Welcome,” we mean it. Considering viewpoints outside of our own as individuals creates a better, more inclusive experience for everyone
We live and breathe inclusion. You will be part of a wide array of voices, opinions, and experiences that inform everything we do
We believe in innovation. You will be part of experimentation; creative problem solving; cross-functional collaboration; testing new approaches, tools and ideas and learning from those tests; and understanding when innovation can drive real impacts and when it may not be needed.
We trust our teams. You’ll own your work, balancing personal accountability with team accountability. Together, we take pride in individual and team contributions; make thoughtful decisions; and want our teammates to succeed.
We care about each other. You’ll join a team that truly lives their values, both in and out of the office. Our Zeebs have honest conversations, give direct feedback, and remember that we are all people here to do great work.
We take thoughtful action. You will be empowered to do the right things as efficiently as possible, not just checking boxes off a list without thinking.

Benefits & Perks

Inclusive and healthy environments are crafted intentionally. Here are some other wonderful perks of working here:

Competitive Compensation & Stock Option Offering
Health, Dental, Vision & Disability Coverages
Sabbatical program for tenured employees
HSA offering + employer contribution
Fertility support through Carrot
$100 monthly wellness perk
$300 pet reimbursement program
401k with match
Unlimited PTO (paid time off) + flexibility to enjoy it
Paid Parental Leave Program
Learning & Development Opportunities

The base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $150,000 per year. The final salary amount will be determined based on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, internal equity, and insights gained throughout the interview process.

About The Zebra

Headquartered in Austin, Texas, The Zebra seeks to bring transparency and simplicity to car and home insurance shopping – it's Insurance in black and white.®

We've garnered attention across the industry and across the nation. Check out all of our awards & recognition!

Our core motto is "All Stripes Welcome." As part of our dedication to maintaining an inclusive and diverse workforce, we provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform core job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. jobs.description:
What you will do:

Lead the team in the development of the project charter and management plan. Direct, manage, monitor, and control project. Evaluate tradeoffs within project.
Meet with project stakeholders to understand and refine project scope; review with manager for approval. Create detailed Work Breakdown Structure.
Develop and manage the detailed project Gantt chart. Analyze critical path and major workstreams.
Collaborate with supervisor and/or project PM to establish sub-project budget. Monitor and maintain costs within budget.
Partner with project team to create project Quality Plans using 1-2 quality planning tools and techniques. Monitor and maintain plans.
Develop a risk management plan for the project. Identify, analyze and understand project risks, develop and monitor a risk response plan.
Contribute in the development of a Procurement Management Plan and collaborate on the selection of procurement partners
Estimate, acquire and assign project team resources. Define the role, responsibility, and deliverables for each team member. Provide direct feedback to functional manager on performance reviews.
Develop a Stakeholder management plan for the project, based on the identification, analysis and understanding of Stakeholder expectations.
Develop and Execute the communications management plan for project team and the needs of key stakeholders
Additional role-specific technical areas of responsibilities may be added as deemed necessary by the local hiring manager.
Builds successful working relationships with internal and external personnel in various departments. Understands quality system(s).
High in emotional intelligence and stays calm under pressure. Adept in conflict resolution
Drives results in support of the business, even in the face of demanding timelines. Steps up to take on additional responsibility where appropriate
Adept at team management: selects the right people to the right tasks all while maintain team morale and recognizing contributions.
Can influence without direct authority in a way that makes others want to be on their team.
Incorporates end-user feedback to refine scope through the project lifecycle and can communicate changes, updates and decisions to key stakeholders
Can understand and communicate how goals fit into broader organizational goals, and prioritize tasks/schedule accordingly.
Keeps the customer at the heart of what we do
Exercises good judgment and can weigh benefits and risk in order to make solid decisions despite ambiguity
Growth mindset – ability to learn quickly and adapt to a changing environment.
Additional role-specific knowledge and capabilities may be added as deemed necessary by the local hiring manager.

Minimum Qualifications (Required):

BS or equivalent and 4+ years of work experience

Preferred Qualifications (Strongly desired):

PMP or equivalent preferred

United Kingdom Pay Ranges:

United Kingdom: £42,600 - £70,900 GBP Annual

At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Company Description

Founded in 2000, The Linux Foundation supports developer communities on a global scale, providing the necessary tools, training, research, guidance, and events to scale open source projects in ways that cannot be achieved by any single entity.

The Agentic AI Foundation is at the forefront of the open source artificial intelligence revolution. As autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration frameworks, and standardized agent-to-agent communication protocols reshape software development, our foundation brings together top AI researchers, engineers, and enterprise leaders to build open, interoperable, and safe agentic systems. Together with our global community, we are solving the complex technical and governance challenges required to scale agentic workflows globally.

Job Description

We are looking for a technical bridge-builder and builder-at-heart to serve as Senior Technical Program Manager for the Agentic AI Foundation. This high-impact role requires a rare blend of hands-on AI engineering technical acumen and expert open source program management.

In this position, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle and onboarding of new open source projects, working groups, and Special Interest Groups (SIGs) across the agentic ecosystem -- ranging from core agent frameworks and model context protocol implementations to evaluation benchmarks and multi-agent orchestration layers. You will work directly alongside AAIF staff, Technical Committee members, project maintainers, and working group chairs to drive technical roadmaps, clear development bottlenecks, and accelerate project milestones and code deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

Project and Working Group Lifecycle -- Lead the onboarding, governance structure, incubation, lifecycle management, and graduation phases for new agentic AI open source projects and working groups
Technical Milestone Acceleration -- Partner directly with Working Group and Project Chairs to define roadmap goals, track technical deliverables, remove blockers, and drive consistent velocity across code repositories
Hands-on Technical Facilitation -- Engage deeply with architecture discussions, API standardizations (e.g., tool-calling protocols, memory layers, multi-agent communication), and release management
Community and Ecosystem Growth -- Help recruit, engage, and retain developer contributors, enterprise adopters, special interest groups, and steering committee members across global time zones and organizational boundaries
Process and Tooling Alignment -- Deploy LF tools (such as LFX) to track contributor analytics, security compliance, project health, and PMO operations across all foundation initiatives

Qualifications

Technical Acumen and Building Experience

Demonstrated experience building LLM-driven agents or multi-agent workflows (e.g., utilizing frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, or custom tool-calling engines)
Solid understanding of modern AI stacks, including context window optimization, Model Context Protocol (MCP), vector databases, agentic memory architectures, and evaluation frameworks
Comfortable reviewing technical proposals, architecture diagrams, APIs, and RFCs to bridge discussions between maintainers and steering committees

Program Management and Execution

Proven track record managing project lifecycles, working group charters, and governance frameworks in open source or multi-stakeholder technology environments
Ability to turn high-level technical vision into actionable milestones, roadmaps, and delivery schedules
Experience leveraging metric platforms (e.g., GitHub insights, LFX, Jira) to measure project health, contributor velocity, and open pull requests

Leadership and Influence

Expertise in leading and building consensus among teams, companies, and community members who do not report to you directly
Ability to engage with VP/CTO-level stakeholders to convey project impact while remaining deeply connected to maintainers and individual contributors
Deep familiarity with trends, disruptions, and emerging standards across the generative AI and agentic software landscape

Salary $165,000 - $205,000 USD

We are as passionate about providing a flexible and supportive work culture as we are about open source software. Collaboration is in our DNA, and we pride ourselves on working closely together regardless of distance.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Center for Geospatial Solutions (CGS) is a self-sustaining nonprofit enterprise. Founded to help bridge the gap between policy and practice, our mission is to enable people and the planet to meet the pace of change by expanding access to new technologies that power more sustainable and equitable outcomes.

We are a fully remote team of award-winning professionals with decades of applied expertise and end-to-end GIS capabilities. By embracing whole-system thinking and state-of-the-art technology, we enable partners across public, private, and nonprofit sectors to tackle complex, real-world challenges—like housing affordability, ecosystem conservation, water management, and sustainable infrastructure—with greater clarity.

Our work liberates and connects key information, creates nuanced pictures of complex situations, and makes land, water, and social data easier to use, understand, and act on. We use tools like satellite data and artificial intelligence to deliver insights for impact.

At CGS, we believe that technology can be a tool for positive change. We are dedicated to building a diverse team that represents the communities and systems we live and work in. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity, and lived experiences, and know a more inclusive team makes us a stronger organization.

About The Lincoln Institute

CGS was established in 2020 at the Lincoln Institute of Land Policy, which seeks to improve quality of life through the effective use, taxation, and stewardship of land. A nonprofit private operating foundation whose origins date to 1946, the Lincoln Institute researches and recommends creative approaches to land as a solution to economic, social, and environmental challenges. Through education, training, publications, and events, the Lincoln Institute integrates theory and practice to inform public policy decisions worldwide and has office locations in Cambridge, Massachusetts; Washington, DC; Phoenix, Arizona; and Beijing, China.

Position Overview

The Center for Geospatial Solutions (CGS) is seeking a Senior Project Manager to coordinate the successful delivery of geospatial, data, AI, and environmental projects for public, private, nonprofit, and philanthropic partners.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Solutions, the Senior Project Manager will translate contracts and scopes of work into practical plans, track schedules and budgets, coordinate technical teams, manage client communications, and help identify and resolve risks before they affect delivery. The role will lead project planning, financial and contractual management, client engagement, risk management, and coordination of cross-functional technical teams, often across multiple organizations, disciplines, and workstreams.

The Senior Project Manager will exercise substantial independent judgment to manage complex project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies, and client expectations and will be responsible to anticipate and resolve complex client delivery challenges before they affect project outcomes. The position will regularly work with senior client stakeholders, technical leads, organizational leadership, subcontractors, and external partners.

In addition to managing assigned projects, the Senior Project Manager will help strengthen CGS's organization-wide project delivery practices by mentoring staff, developing tools and standards, identifying systemic delivery risks, and improving how CGS manages increasingly larger and more complex client engagements.

What You Will Do

Complex Project Delivery

Lead multiple complex geospatial, data, AI, software, or environmental projects from contract execution and kickoff through delivery, acceptance, and closeout.
Develop and own integrated project-management plans translating contracts, technical approaches, and scopes of work into schedules, workstreams, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resource plans, decision points, and acceptance criteria.
Lead delivery across multidisciplinary teams that may include geospatial analysts, data scientists, software engineers, environmental scientists, product specialists, subcontractors, and external partners.
Exercise independent judgment to resolve project-level issues involving priorities, staffing, sequencing, technical dependencies, client expectations, and competing contractual requirements.
Maintain project plans, meeting notes, decision logs, action registers, and team coordination using Monday.com or comparable tools.
Coordinate staffing and work-sequencing with technical staff and organizational managers.
Track deliverable status and ensure reviews, approvals, and client submissions occur on time.

Client and Stakeholder Responsibilities

Serve as a primary day-to-day lead and trusted advisor for assigned clients and partners, including senior government, nonprofit, philanthropic, and private-sector stakeholders.
Lead client meetings, executive-level project updates, planning sessions, reviews, and difficult conversations concerning scope, schedule, performance, risk, or changing priorities.
Set and manage expectations regarding scope, schedule, roles, dependencies, data needs, and technical constraints.
Build trusted client relationships and identify concerns or opportunities that should be elevated to others.
Identify follow-on opportunities, changing client needs, and potential extensions of work and communicate them to the appropriate parties.
Represent CGS professionally in multi-organization project teams, steering groups, and other external forums.

Budget, Scope, and Risk Management

Own project-level financial management for assigned engagements, including budgets, burn rates, labor plans, subcontractor costs, forecasts, invoicing inputs, and estimates to complete.
Identify scope changes, delivery risks, resource constraints, and unresolved decisions early and handle timely mitigation.
Lead change-management processes when client requirements or project assumptions change, including documenting impacts and supporting amendments, modifications, or revised scopes.
Support management of federally funded contracts, grants, cooperative agreements, and subawards, including coordination of applicable reporting and compliance requirements.
Maintain clear documentation to support financial oversight, contractual accountability, audits, and organizational decision-making.

Team Leadership and Organizational Project Management

Coach and mentor project managers, technical leads, and other staff in project planning, client management, financial management, risk identification, and delivery practices.
Create and maintain clear operating rhythms for project teams, including planning sessions, standups, reviews, retrospectives, risk reviews, and executive status reporting, without relying on direct supervisory authority, to establish clarity around project responsibilities, priorities, deadlines, and decision-making.
Promote consistent use of CGS project-management practices while adapting the level of process to the needs of each project.
Analyze lessons across projects and recommend changes that improve delivery predictability, financial performance, client experience, and organizational scalability.

jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

Job Summary

The Staff Project Manager is a senior individual contributor within OpenGov's Professional Services Strategic Projects team, responsible for owning delivery on specific multi-suite, high-complexity government implementations. This role sits above the Lead/Sr. PM tier and below Principal PM: the Staff PM defines and oversees implementation strategy for the projects assigned to them, without holding people-management authority and without the org-wide, cross-portfolio strategy mandate carried by the Principal PM.

The Staff PM operates as the connective tissue on their assigned engagements — coordinating Solutions Architecture, Technical, and Change Management functions, managing scope and risk with commercial discipline, and serving as the primary program-level point of contact for Director- and VP-level client stakeholders. The role requires the judgment to run a complex, multi-department implementation independently, while building the documentation and governance habits that make the engagement defensible under scrutiny.

This is an individual-contributor role. Influence across matrixed delivery teams — SA, Technical, Change Management, and vertical resources — is exercised through structured process and stakeholder trust, not direct authority.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Own end-to-end delivery for one or more multi-suite, multi-department government implementations, including cross-workstream sequencing and phased go-live planning.
Apply matrix program management discipline to coordinate SA, Technical, and Change Management resources without direct reporting authority over those functions.
Establish and maintain project governance artifacts: RAID logs, decision registers, escalation paths, and configuration-freeze protocols appropriate to the engagement's complexity.
Define scope boundaries at the project and workstream level; identify client-side triggers for change orders and document them in writing before they become disputes.
Escalate risks to the Principal PM / Sr. Director with enough lead time for intervention — no risk is surfaced for the first time in a client meeting.

Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary point of accountability for Director- and VP-level client stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Navigate multi-department client governance, competing priorities, and shifting decision-makers with professionalism and a clear paper trail.
Deliver structured, client-ready status reporting, escalation memos, steering committee materials, and go/no-go readiness briefs.
Partner with Sales and PS Leadership during scoping on assigned or prospective engagements to assess delivery feasibility and inform SOW structure.

Delivery Governance & Quality

Define and enforce go-live readiness criteria, configuration-freeze processes, and UAT acceptance standards for assigned engagements.
Proactively identify project-level risks — scope, resource, timeline, and client-readiness — and own mitigation plans through resolution.
Lead root-cause analysis on delivery issues that span multiple workstreams; document findings and surface them to the Principal PM / PS leadership when the fix has implications beyond the current engagement.
Ensure delivery consistency through adherence to PS methodology and shared tooling (RocketLane, Salesforce), and contribute observations to playbook development.

Change Management & Client Enablement

Coordinate change management activities for assigned implementations — organizational readiness, adoption risk, and stakeholder alignment across departments — in partnership with the Change Management function.
Advise client stakeholders on readiness gaps and adoption risk specific to their governmental constraints and political dynamics.
Guide clients through scope evolution without losing delivery momentum or allowing verbal-only agreements to stand as commitments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

Act as a day-to-day resource and informal mentor for Lead/Sr. PMs and Implementation Consultants staffed on the same engagements.
Identify delivery trends within assigned engagements — scope patterns, resource gaps, client-readiness indicators — and raise them to PS leadership with a recommendation.
Partner with Product and Engineering to route field delivery observations into product feedback for the assigned account(s).
Feed engagement-specific learnings from multi-department, multi-suite projects up to the Principal PM and PS leadership for incorporation into the broader delivery methodology.

Experience

Requirements and Preferred Experience

5–7 years of progressive program and project management experience in a SaaS environment, including ownership of at least one enterprise-scale, multi-product implementation.
Demonstrated experience coordinating across implementation, product, engineering, and sales functions without direct authority over those teams.
Experience with complex governmental clients or equivalent regulated/public-sector environments; understanding of procurement constraints and multi-department governance is strongly preferred.
Prior experience supporting SOW language, change-order rationale, or commercial framing in partnership with sales or PS leadership.

Technical & Analytical Proficiency

Strong technical aptitude for enterprise SaaS platforms and deployment methodology, including configuration management, data migration oversight, and integration coordination.
Proficiency with project/program management tooling and CRM platforms (RocketLane, Salesforce, or equivalent).
Ability to evaluate cross-system dependencies and resource constraints and translate findings into clear, actionable mitigation plans.
Working knowledge of project-level budget tracking and delivery-margin awareness for assigned engagements (portfolio-level forecasting sits with the Principal PM).

Communication & Stakeholder Influence

Strong written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to produce client-ready documentation (status briefs, steering committee materials, escalation memos).
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority — aligning cross-functional teams and driving accountability across a matrixed environment.
Skilled at translating technical delivery complexity into clear narrative for non-technical client stakeholders and department-level executives.

Certifications & Methodology

PMP certification preferred; Scrum Master (CSM or PSM) or SAFe Agile certification accepted as equivalent or supplementary.
Prosci, CCMP, or equivalent Change Management certification a plus.
Working knowledge of PMBOK, Agile, and hybrid delivery frameworks.

Additional Requirements

Willingness to travel to client sites for discovery, steering committee meetings, go-live support, and executive relationship management.
Bachelor's degree preferred or commensurate experience demonstrating the ability to perform the responsibilities above.
This is an individual-contributor role with cross-functional influence; people-management experience is not required, though mentorship capability is expected.

Compensation

San Francisco, CA: $160,000 - $180,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

Why OpenGov?

A Mission That Matters.

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

Benefits That Work For You

Job Description

As Senior Project Manager, Special Projects
, you will independently coordinate and drive construction-focused data center projects and complex workstreams across remediation, retrofit, expansion, and infrastructure improvement programs. You will provide structured project leadership across schedules, risks, dependencies, documentation, stakeholder alignment, and operational readiness to ensure projects are delivered safely, predictably, and with clear accountability.

You will partner closely with project managers, construction managers, engineering teams, commissioning partners, site operations, procurement, vendors, contractors, and technical SMEs. At this level, you are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, anticipate project risks, resolve coordination challenges, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and establish scalable project controls and execution practices across multiple concurrent initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Independently coordinate complex Special Projects construction activities across multiple sites, projects, or interconnected workstreams.
Own and maintain integrated project controls, including schedules, milestone plans, action registers, risk and issue logs, decision logs, dependency tracking, and project documentation repositories.
Drive cross-functional project cadence, including planning sessions, readiness reviews, technical coordination meetings, risk reviews, and executive or leadership status updates.
Identify schedule, scope, dependency, resource, procurement, commissioning, and operational-readiness risks and drive mitigation plans with accountable stakeholders.
Coordinate critical project deliverables including submittals, RFIs, closeout documentation, commissioning evidence, punch lists, turnover requirements, as-builts, warranties, and operational handoff packages.
Lead readiness tracking across Construction, Engineering, Operations, Commissioning, Procurement, vendors, and other technical stakeholders to ensure prerequisites and dependencies are resolved before key milestones.
Develop clear, concise project reporting that communicates milestone health, schedule exposure, critical risks, decisions required, blockers, dependencies, and recovery actions to project and senior leadership.
Drive accountability for open actions by establishing clear owners, commitments, due dates, escalation paths, and closure criteria.
Coordinate procurement status, vendor dependencies, logistics, site access, material readiness, site visits, and other execution requirements that could affect project delivery.
Anticipate cross-functional conflicts and delivery risks, facilitate resolution, and escalate issues with clear impact assessments and recommended actions.
Ensure project records meet expectations for audit readiness, warranty management, asset onboarding, safety, commissioning, operational acceptance, and long-term documentation integrity.
Develop and improve standardized project controls, templates, reporting methods, meeting structures, dashboards, and documentation practices that can be adopted across the broader Special Projects organization.
Analyze recurring execution issues and project trends to identify systemic gaps and recommend improvements to processes, governance, planning, and delivery practices.
Support or mentor less-experienced project coordinators and team members in project controls, documentation standards, stakeholder management, and execution discipline.
Manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities with limited supervision while maintaining accurate reporting, timely escalation, and strong stakeholder communication.
Reinforce safety, security, access-control, change-management, and active-site requirements throughout project planning and execution.

Experience improving project-management processes, controls, reporting practices, templates, or operating mechanisms across teams or programs.
Strong judgment, written communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing project environments.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in construction management, engineering, business, operations, project management, or a related field.

Advanced project planning, coordination, and execution discipline across complex, interdependent workstreams.
Strong ownership mentality with the ability to independently drive projects and issues from identification through closure.
Ability to recognize schedule, technical, operational, procurement, and execution risks before they materially affect project milestones.
Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills across technical, operational, construction, vendor, and leadership organizations.
Ability to manage competing priorities and dependencies across multiple projects, sites, and stakeholder groups.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate project data into meaningful insights, risks, priorities, and recommended actions.
Ability to communicate complex technical and project information clearly to both technical teams and senior leadership.
Strong document-control and project-governance mindset with emphasis on accuracy, traceability, completeness, version control, and auditability.
Demonstrated ability to establish scalable processes and improve project execution through standardization, lessons learned, and continuous improvement.
Ability to mentor and provide project execution guidance to less-experienced team members.
Sound judgment and decision-making skills in active, mission-critical environments where safety, reliability, and operational continuity are essential.

Experience developing or managing integrated schedules, milestone tracking, critical-path dependencies, risk registers, executive dashboards, and portfolio-level reporting.

jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

Job Summary

The Staff Project Manager is a senior individual contributor within OpenGov's Professional Services Strategic Projects team, responsible for owning delivery on specific multi-suite, high-complexity government implementations. This role sits above the Lead/Sr. PM tier and below Principal PM: the Staff PM defines and oversees implementation strategy for the projects assigned to them, without holding people-management authority and without the org-wide, cross-portfolio strategy mandate carried by the Principal PM.

The Staff PM operates as the connective tissue on their assigned engagements — coordinating Solutions Architecture, Technical, and Change Management functions, managing scope and risk with commercial discipline, and serving as the primary program-level point of contact for Director- and VP-level client stakeholders. The role requires the judgment to run a complex, multi-department implementation independently, while building the documentation and governance habits that make the engagement defensible under scrutiny.

This is an individual-contributor role. Influence across matrixed delivery teams — SA, Technical, Change Management, and vertical resources — is exercised through structured process and stakeholder trust, not direct authority.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Own end-to-end delivery for one or more multi-suite, multi-department government implementations, including cross-workstream sequencing and phased go-live planning.
Apply matrix program management discipline to coordinate SA, Technical, and Change Management resources without direct reporting authority over those functions.
Establish and maintain project governance artifacts: RAID logs, decision registers, escalation paths, and configuration-freeze protocols appropriate to the engagement's complexity.
Define scope boundaries at the project and workstream level; identify client-side triggers for change orders and document them in writing before they become disputes.
Escalate risks to the Principal PM / Sr. Director with enough lead time for intervention — no risk is surfaced for the first time in a client meeting.

Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary point of accountability for Director- and VP-level client stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Navigate multi-department client governance, competing priorities, and shifting decision-makers with professionalism and a clear paper trail.
Deliver structured, client-ready status reporting, escalation memos, steering committee materials, and go/no-go readiness briefs.
Partner with Sales and PS Leadership during scoping on assigned or prospective engagements to assess delivery feasibility and inform SOW structure.

Delivery Governance & Quality

Define and enforce go-live readiness criteria, configuration-freeze processes, and UAT acceptance standards for assigned engagements.
Proactively identify project-level risks — scope, resource, timeline, and client-readiness — and own mitigation plans through resolution.
Lead root-cause analysis on delivery issues that span multiple workstreams; document findings and surface them to the Principal PM / PS leadership when the fix has implications beyond the current engagement.
Ensure delivery consistency through adherence to PS methodology and shared tooling (RocketLane, Salesforce), and contribute observations to playbook development.

Change Management & Client Enablement

Coordinate change management activities for assigned implementations — organizational readiness, adoption risk, and stakeholder alignment across departments — in partnership with the Change Management function.
Advise client stakeholders on readiness gaps and adoption risk specific to their governmental constraints and political dynamics.
Guide clients through scope evolution without losing delivery momentum or allowing verbal-only agreements to stand as commitments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

Act as a day-to-day resource and informal mentor for Lead/Sr. PMs and Implementation Consultants staffed on the same engagements.
Identify delivery trends within assigned engagements — scope patterns, resource gaps, client-readiness indicators — and raise them to PS leadership with a recommendation.
Partner with Product and Engineering to route field delivery observations into product feedback for the assigned account(s).
Feed engagement-specific learnings from multi-department, multi-suite projects up to the Principal PM and PS leadership for incorporation into the broader delivery methodology.

Experience

Requirements and Preferred Experience

5–7 years of progressive program and project management experience in a SaaS environment, including ownership of at least one enterprise-scale, multi-product implementation.
Demonstrated experience coordinating across implementation, product, engineering, and sales functions without direct authority over those teams.
Experience with complex governmental clients or equivalent regulated/public-sector environments; understanding of procurement constraints and multi-department governance is strongly preferred.
Prior experience supporting SOW language, change-order rationale, or commercial framing in partnership with sales or PS leadership.

Technical & Analytical Proficiency

Strong technical aptitude for enterprise SaaS platforms and deployment methodology, including configuration management, data migration oversight, and integration coordination.
Proficiency with project/program management tooling and CRM platforms (RocketLane, Salesforce, or equivalent).
Ability to evaluate cross-system dependencies and resource constraints and translate findings into clear, actionable mitigation plans.
Working knowledge of project-level budget tracking and delivery-margin awareness for assigned engagements (portfolio-level forecasting sits with the Principal PM).

Communication & Stakeholder Influence

Strong written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to produce client-ready documentation (status briefs, steering committee materials, escalation memos).
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority — aligning cross-functional teams and driving accountability across a matrixed environment.
Skilled at translating technical delivery complexity into clear narrative for non-technical client stakeholders and department-level executives.

Certifications & Methodology

PMP certification preferred; Scrum Master (CSM or PSM) or SAFe Agile certification accepted as equivalent or supplementary.
Prosci, CCMP, or equivalent Change Management certification a plus.
Working knowledge of PMBOK, Agile, and hybrid delivery frameworks.

Additional Requirements

Willingness to travel to client sites for discovery, steering committee meetings, go-live support, and executive relationship management.
Bachelor's degree preferred or commensurate experience demonstrating the ability to perform the responsibilities above.
This is an individual-contributor role with cross-functional influence; people-management experience is not required, though mentorship capability is expected.

Compensation

San Francisco, CA: $160,000 - $180,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

A Team of Passionate, Driven People

Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

Benefits That Work For You

jobs.description:
Description -

Job Summary

About The Company

HP Inc. is a global technology leader pioneering innovative solutions that revolutionize the way people work and live. Our Workforce Experience software platform is at the forefront of optimizing digital experiences in the workplace, comprising multiple modules designed to enhance workforce productivity and employee engagement.

About The Position

As a FedRAMP Project / Program Manager, you will support the planning, coordination, and tactical execution of HP’s FedRAMP readiness effort for WXP and related managed services capabilities. This role is focused on keeping the program organized, driving follow-through across workstreams, maintaining the integrated project plan, coordinating stakeholder inputs, gathering and documenting requirements, and ensuring progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions are visible to the right owners.

This role will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, legal, operations, managed services, GTM, and external partner teams to help keep the FedRAMP effort moving against defined milestones. Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, clear communication, follow-up discipline, and the ability to turn cross-functional inputs into actionable plans, status updates, and decision-ready summaries.

Key Responsibilities

Program coordination & execution tracking

Maintain the integrated FedRAMP project plan, including milestones, owners, dependencies, action items, and status updates.
Own day-to-day upkeep of the FedRAMP Smartsheet / program tracker to ensure workstreams, deliverables, risks, and next steps remain current and visible.
Track progress across concurrent FedRAMP workstreams spanning product, engineering, infrastructure, security, compliance, operations, and business teams.
Follow up with workstream owners to drive timely completion of actions, requirements, artifacts, and open decisions.
Help identify schedule risks, blockers, dependency gaps, and execution issues that require escalation.

Stakeholder coordination

Serve as a central coordination point across internal HP stakeholders and external partners supporting the FedRAMP effort.
Schedule and support working sessions, readiness reviews, requirements reviews, and issue-resolution forums.
Capture meeting notes, decisions, owners, and follow-ups, and ensure items are reflected in the program tracker.
Help coordinate delivery expectations with third-party partners, including Coalfire and Amazon, as part of the broader FedRAMP execution plan.
Support clear communication across product, engineering, architecture, security, legal, operations, managed services, GTM, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements Intake & Documentation Support

Gather, organize, and document FedRAMP-related requirements from product, business, security, compliance, and technical stakeholders.
Help maintain requirements inventories, decision logs, artifact trackers, and dependency lists needed to support FedRAMP readiness.
Coordinate inputs for key program artifacts such as architecture documentation, control readiness materials, authorization package inputs, status reports, and executive summaries.
Support requirement clarification by routing questions to the right subject matter experts and tracking unresolved items to closure.
Ensure requirements and action items are documented consistently and connected to relevant milestones, owners, and execution plans.

Reporting & communication

Prepare regular program status updates summarizing progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and decisions needed.
Support leadership and governance updates with clear, concise, executive-ready summaries.
Help translate detailed project activity into clear updates that enable faster decisions and cross-functional alignment.
Maintain organized program documentation so stakeholders can quickly understand status, next steps, and open issues.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field preferred.
5-10 years of experience in project coordination, program management, product operations, technical program support, compliance program support, or a related role.
Exposure to FedRAMP, DoD IL5, cloud compliance, cybersecurity, audit readiness, or authorization programs.
Experience supporting technical or compliance-driven programs in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, legal, or operations teams.
Experience maintaining Smartsheet dashboards, integrated project plans, milestone trackers, risk logs, or executive reporting materials.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining clear documentation and follow-through.
Strong attention to detail and comfort working with complex stakeholder maps, evolving requirements, and shifting priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create concise status updates and coordinate across technical and business stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping bring structure, visibility, and execution discipline to a complex program.

Disclaimer

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

The base pay range for this role is $110,000 to $159,000 annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to US candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:

Health insurance
Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Long term/short term disability insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Life insurance
Generous time off policies, including;
4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
11 paid holidays
Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.
